reader_summary.headline: Stephen McKeon is a Partner at Collab+Currency and Associate Professor of Finance at the University of Oregon.
reader_summary.overview: Stephen McKeon is a Partner at Collab+Currency and Associate Professor of Finance at the University of Oregon, where is teaches a course on crypto assets. As an investor, Stephen focuses on consumer facing applications of crypto. He was a past guest on the show back in 2018 discussing security tokens.

key_points.text: That replay is available in the feed and sheds light on how far the crypto ecosystem has come over the last four years.
Our conversation begins with a reflection on Steve's security token thesis, his shift to investing, and his strategy at Collab+Currency.
We dive into NFTs, DAOs, the metaverse and gaming, including the latest state of play and his investment thesis around each.
